title: Vanguard store document engine fields
description: The engine-owned frontmatter contract every store document under .vanguard/docs/ must satisfy. Everything outside these fields is user-defined and opaque to the engine. The structure layer (M2) enforces this schema at discovery time; until then it is the reviewed contract.

id.description: Document identity; must equal the file name without extension and be unique across the store.

schema.description: Optional name of the JSON Schema in .vanguard/schemas/ that binds this document's content (file <name>.schema.json). Important documents declare one; some documents legitimately have none.

paths.description: Globs over the target repository; churn inside any matched path makes the document stale.

review_after.description: Clock-axis staleness: h/d/w/mo/y, a bare integer means days.

bindings.description: Names of allowlisted bindings from vanguard.yaml; never inline commands.
